args.question: Find precedents in this corpus about maritime salvage rights and shipping collision liability under admiralty law.
args.answer:
**No relevant precedents found.** The corpus of 56 judgments contains no cases involving maritime salvage rights, shipping collision liability, or admiralty law. 

The corpus is composed overwhelmingly of motor accident compensation cases under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, along with a few unrelated civil, criminal, and commercial disputes (specific performance, negotiable instruments, trademark infringement, personality rights, etc.). None of the judgments deal with:
- Admiralty jurisdiction or the Admiralty Act, 2017
- Maritime salvage rights
- Collision of vessels/ships at sea
- Navigation or shipping law
- Any dispute arising on the high seas or involving vessels

I searched using multiple methods — semantic/keyword search, exact metadata filtering (by case type, statute, and principle keywords), and an exhaustive screen of all 56 judgment summaries — all with negative results.
